name: Journal Entry-custom_party_name

name: Item-qc_hold
label: QC Hold (Quarantine)
description: If checked, stock of this item is placed in quarantine warehouse pending QC clearance

name: Stock Entry-custom_qc_system_generated
label: QC System-Generated
description: Phase 4: set automatically on Stock Entries the QC quarantine workflow creates itself (quarantine placement, release-on-pass, scrap write-off, return-to-supplier). Used to exempt these from the guard that otherwise blocks any Stock Entry sourcing stock out of a quarantine warehouse -- quarantine stock may only leave via this system-generated path, never a manually authored entry.
